dict.string: Toolbox reads Finder selections and uses Apple Pages locally to convert Pages documents.
Toolbox uses the camera to add a webcam overlay to screen recordings.
Toolbox opens the files you pick on your Desktop and saves the results next to them.
Toolbox opens the files you pick in Documents and saves the results next to them.
Toolbox opens the files you pick in Downloads, and saves recordings and results there.
Share on Wi-Fi and Whiteboard let phones and computers on your network open a private link to this Mac. Nothing goes through the internet.
Toolbox uses the microphone to record audio, narrate screen recordings, and transcribe dictation.
Toolbox records your screen when you start a screen recording.
Toolbox transcribes audio on your Mac. Nothing is uploaded.
